content:
jamie: Quick heads-up — prepping the EU midnight slice. Using this thread for the last-mile prelaunch checklist. Target window 00:00-01:00 UTC. I will call pins, rollbacks, and sign-offs here.
noah: ACK. I'll kick off canary smoke in ~10m and post results.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated for release v3.4.2-eu (canary=5%). status: in_progress. id: cb-3188-01
priya: Quick question — runtime pin: v3.4.2 or do we keep v3.4.1-hotfix pinned? My preference: pin v3.4.2 with fallback to v3.4.1.
jamie: agree. pin v3.4.2 with fallback to v3.4.1. Priya can you apply?
priya: done. Command: `/pin v3.4.2 --fallback v3.4.1`
deploy-bot: Pin applied on eu-slice: v3.4.2 (fallback=v3.4.1). command_id: pin-921.
noah: Smoke run finished. p95 latency 180ms, error_rate 0.10% (baseline 0.08%). embeddings path shows a small quality regression. Logs snip: ```POST /v1/embeddings 200 0.12% errors; tail: timeout spikes at 3s for ~0.05% requests```
melissa: p95 is within SLO (<=200ms) — ok for canary. But embeddings regression needs a watch. Priya, are model changes expected here?
priya: We landed a quantization tweak in the model pack; small embed drift expected. I'm OK moving forward with a watch and quality alerts. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/3.4.2 (see "embedding-quality" section).
jamie: Rollback criteria (recording): immediate unpin + traffic redirect to v3.4.1 if ANY of: errors > 1% sustained for 5m, p95 > 250ms for 5m, or embeddings_quality_drop > 0.05 for 10m. Ops to run DB drain if we rollback.
ops_bot: Alert policy created: embeddings_quality_drop > 0.05 OR error_rate > 1 OR p95 > 250ms for 5m -> notify #eng-oncall and call /rollback. runbook linked.
noah: Running final preflight: `./scripts/preflight_check.sh --slice eu --release v3.4.2` Output: OK except embeddings_warning=true. attaching output blob.
jamie: Need explicit sign-off from release leads. @melissa @priya please +1 to proceed with canary ramp to 25%.
melissa: +1. I'll keep eyes on dashboards and product comms.
priya: +1. Recommend ramp to 25% now, warmup 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 25% at 3188887830. warmup_end=3188888130.
jamie: Quiet period starts 23:45 UTC. Reminder: freeze on non-critical merges, no roll-forward changes except hotfixes.
melissa: Release notes broadcasted to #product and sales notified. link above.
ops_bot: Final smoke at 3188887890: no new errors, key metrics stable. Ready for traffic ramp.
noah: Runbook and playbook pinned: https://go.redwood/runbooks/prelaunch-slice-3.4.2 — oncall roster: @noah @melissa.
jamie: OK — if any metric crosses threshold call for rollback immediately. Otherwise we proceed with scheduled ramp at 00:00 UTC.
ops_bot: GO received from melissa and priya at 3188887900. Scheduled ramp starting at 00:00 UTC. :rocket:
